ROW.COLUMN: Financial institutions typically monitor repeated non-financial inquiry by employee on accounts which may potentially lead to fraudulent activity.
Primary Rule for Repeated Inquiry, Employee Focus

--Primary Rule for Repeated Inquiry select E.EMP_SEQ_ID EMP_SEQ_ID, E.EMP_INTRL_ID EMP_INTRL_ID, ACE.ACCT_INTRL_ID ACCT_INTRL_ID, count(ACE.ACCESS_EVENT_SEQ_ID) INQUIRY_CNT, count(distinct ACE.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_CD) CHANNEL_CNT from @BUSINESS@.EMP E inner join @BUSINESS@.NTWK_LOGON NL on E.EMP_INTRL_ID = NL.NTWK_USER_INTRL_ID inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT_ACCESS_EVENT ACE on ACE.TRXN_ENTRY_NTWK_LOGON_ID = NL.NTWK_LOGON_ID inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT AC on AC.ACCT_INTRL_ID = ACE.ACCT_INTRL_ID where -- Include Customer Retail Accounts Only AC.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD = 'CR' -- Include Open or Active Accounts and AC.ACCT_STAT_CD = 'A' --Exclude Employees personal accounts and AC.ACCT_INTRL_ID not in (select NUAM.ACCT_INTRL_ID from @BUSINESS@.NTWK_USER_ACCT_MAP NUAM where NUAM.EMP_INTRL_ID=E.EMP_INTRL_ID) --All Jurisdictions, Included Jurisdiction Codes and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl= 'Y' or E.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incld_Jurisdictions_Lst)) -- All Access Event Primary Purpose, Included Access Event Primary Purpose Codes and (@All_Access_Evt_Pr_Fl = 'Y' or ACE.PRMRY_PURP_DESC_TX in (@Incld_Prmry_Purp_Lst)) -- All Trxn Channels, Included Transaction Channel Codes and (@All_Trans_Chnl_Fl = 'Y' or ACE.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_CD IN (@Incld_Trans_Chnl_Lst)) --To include Mantas BUSINESS Acct Types and AC.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD in (@Mantas_Bus_Acct_Typ_Lst) --LookBack Period Tunable and ACE.ACCESS_EVENT_DT <= (select B.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and ACE.ACCESS_EVENT_DT > (select B.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = @LookBack_Period) group by E.EMP_SEQ_ID, E.EMP_INTRL_ID, ACE.ACCT_INTRL_ID having -- Frequency Period Filter max(ACE.ACCESS_EVENT_DT) > (select B.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = @Frequency_Period) --Minimum Inquiry Count and count(ACE.ACCESS_EVENT_SEQ_ID) >= @Min_Inquiry_Cnt
Access Event Building Block for Repeated Inquiry, Employee Focus

--Building Block ACCT_ACCESS_EVENT for Repeated Inquiry select E.EMP_INTRL_ID EMP_INTRL_ID, ACE.ACCT_INTRL_ID ACCT_INTRL_ID, ACE.ACCESS_EVENT_SEQ_ID from @BUSINESS@.EMP E inner join @BUSINESS@.NTWK_LOGON NL on E.EMP_INTRL_ID = NL.NTWK_USER_INTRL_ID inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT_ACCESS_EVENT ACE on ACE.TRXN_ENTRY_NTWK_LOGON_ID = NL.NTWK_LOGON_ID inner join @BUSINESS@.ACCT AC on AC.ACCT_INTRL_ID = ACE.ACCT_INTRL_ID where -- Include Customer Retail Accounts Only AC.MANTAS_ACCT_HOLDR_TYPE_CD = 'CR' -- Include Open or Active Accounts and AC.ACCT_STAT_CD = 'A' --Exclude Employees personal accounts and AC.ACCT_INTRL_ID not in(select NUAM.ACCT_INTRL_ID from @BUSINESS@.NTWK_USER_ACCT_MAP NUAM where NUAM.EMP_INTRL_ID=E.EMP_INTRL_ID) --All Jurisdictions, Included Jurisdiction Codes and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl= 'Y' or E.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incld_Jurisdictions_Lst)) -- All Access Event Primary Purpose, Included Access Event Primary Purpose Codes and (@All_Access_Evt_Pr_Fl = 'Y' or ACE.PRMRY_PURP_DESC_TX in (@Incld_Prmry_Purp_Lst)) -- All Trxn Channels, Included Transaction Channel Codes and (@All_Trans_Chnl_Fl = 'Y' or ACE.MANTAS_TRXN_CHANL_CD IN (@Incld_Trans_Chnl_Lst)) --To include Mantas BUSINESS_TEST59_1 Acct Types and AC.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD in (@Mantas_Bus_Acct_Typ_Lst) --LookBack Period Tunable and ACE.ACCESS_EVENT_DT <= (select B.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and ACE.ACCESS_EVENT_DT > (select B.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL B where B.CLNDR_NM = @Calendar_Name and B.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = @LookBack_Period)

Parameter that allows the coverage of all jurisdictions without enumerating them in the Included Jurisdiction Codes threshold. Y: Covers all jurisdiction codes regardless of the Included Jurisdiction Code threshold value. N: Covers only those jurisdictions that are listed in the Included Jurisdiction Codes threshold.

Parameter that allows the coverage of all Access Event Primary Purpose without enumerating them in the Included Access Event Primary Purpose threshold. Y: Covers all Access Event Primary Purpose regardless of the Included Access Event Primary Purpose threshold value. N: Covers only those Access Event Primary Purpose that are listed in the Included Access Event Primary Purpose threshold.

Parameter that allows the coverage of all transaction channel codes for non-financial transactions / inquiries without enumerating them in the Included Trxn Channel threshold. Y: Covers all transaction channel codes for non-financial transactions / inquiries regardless of the Included Trxn Channel threshold value. N: Covers only those transaction channel codes for non-financial transactions / inquiries that are listed in the Included Trxn Channel threshold.
The name of the calendar to be used in this scenario. This is to accommodate calendars from different countries if needed.
This parameter shows the frequency of executing the scenario.
The list of transaction channel(s) included in this scenario for non-financial transaction inquiry.
Minimum number of non-financial inquiry needed to generate an alert in this scenario.
The list of account access event primary purpose covered in this scenario. The firm defines allowable values for the Access Event: Primary Purpose of Access Event field, as described in the DIS.
The list of jurisdiction codes that the scenario covers. The client defines allowable values.
Number of calendar days in the lookback period.
Codes that identify the business purpose or usage of this account for Oracle scenarios.
Retreive all the Employees and Accounts where there repeated non-financial inquiry
